turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Patil from Pune?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Patil. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Inspector Vikram Singh from the Cyber Intelligence unit. We have intercepted a package containing illegal narcotics and several fake passports sent in your name.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What? That is impossible, I have not sent any package!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is why we are calling you. Your Aadhaar card has been used for this crime and you are now under digital arrest until this is cleared.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Digital arrest? I do not understand, please tell me what is happening.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not hang up or tell anyone, otherwise it will be seen as tampering with evidence and we will send a team to your house immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am very worried, my son is not home. What should I do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You must cooperate with the government. To prove your innocence and clear your name from the database, you need to transfer a security verification fee.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Verification fee? How much are you talking about?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is eighty thousand rupees. Once the department verifies the funds, your name will be cleared and the case closed.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That is a lot of money, can I go to the police station instead?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you leave this call, you will be arrested on the spot. Transfer the money to this secure government account now to avoid jail.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Please give me a moment, I need to find my glasses.
